ESTA Requirements for Brunei Citizens

As a citizen of Brunei, you are eligible to apply for ESTA under the U.S. Visa Waiver Program. To qualify, you must meet the following requirements:

Passport Requirements

  • ✓Hold a valid Brunei passport
  • ✓Must be an e-Passport with electronic chip
  • ✓Valid for at least 6 months beyond your stay

Travel Requirements

  • ✓Tourism, business, or transit purposes only
  • ✓Planning to stay 90 days or less
  • ✓Have return/onward travel ticket

Eligibility Criteria

  • ✓No criminal record or visa violations
  • ✓In good health
  • ✓Not a dual citizen of restricted countries

Additional Requirements

  • ✓Valid email address for notifications
  • ✓Payment method (credit/debit card)
  • ✓Accommodation details in the U.S.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions from Brunei citizens about ESTA

Q:Do Brunei citizens need ESTA for USA?

A: Yes, Brunei citizens need ESTA (Electronic System for Travel Authorization) to visit the United States for tourism or business stays of 90 days or less. Brunei is part of the Visa Waiver Program, which allows eligible travelers to enter the U.S. without a visa if they have an approved ESTA.

Q:How long does ESTA approval take for Brunei citizens?

A: Most ESTA applications for Brunei citizens are approved within 24 hours. However, it can take up to 72 hours in some cases. We recommend applying at least 72 hours before your departure to ensure you receive your approval in time.

Q:How much does ESTA cost for Brunei travelers?

A: The total cost is $45 USD, which includes the government fee of $40 and our service fee of $5. Our service provides expert assistance, application review, and 24/7 support to ensure your ESTA is approved correctly.

Q:How long is ESTA valid for Brunei citizens?

A: An approved ESTA is valid for 2 years from the date of approval, or until your passport expires, whichever comes first. During this time, you can make multiple trips to the United States, with each stay limited to 90 days.

Q:Can Brunei citizens work in the USA with ESTA?

A: No, ESTA does not permit Brunei citizens to work in the United States. ESTA is only for tourism, business meetings, conferences, or transit purposes. If you plan to work in the U.S., you must apply for the appropriate work visa.
